bg-irr-01-01.h: More ㅡ Irregular Stems (예쁘다, 쓰다, 크다)

bg-irr-01-01.hint: The vowel ㅡ drops before vowels; since the preceding vowel is ㅏ, attach -아요.
bg-irr-01-01.why: 아프다 drops ㅡ and takes -아요 because the stem vowel is ㅏ → 아파요.

bg-irr-01-01.hint: 바쁘다 drops ㅡ; the vowel before it is ㅏ, so it takes -아요.
bg-irr-01-01.why: 바쁘- drops ㅡ, leaving 바- (vowel ㅏ), which combines with -아요 → 바빠요.
바쁘다 drops ㅡ and attaches 아요 to become 바빠요.

bg-irr-01-01.q: State that your head hurts using 머리가 and 아파요.
bg-irr-01-01.why: 아프다 loses ㅡ and takes -아요: 머리가 아파요.

items: Drop stem vowel ㅡ when conjugating before vowel endings
Determine whether -아요 or -어요 follows based on the preceding vowel

bg-irr-01-02.hint: ㅂ changes to 우 before vowel endings: 추우 + 어요 → 추워요.
bg-irr-01-02.why: 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective. ㅂ becomes 우 before vowels → 추워요.

bg-irr-01-02.hint: 맵다 changes ㅂ to 우 before -어요: 매우 + 어요 → 매워요.
bg-irr-01-02.why: 맵다 drops ㅂ to add 우, conjugating to 매워요.
덥다 turns ㅂ into 우, attaching -어요 to become 더워요.

bg-irr-01-02.q: State that Korean is easy using 한국어가 and 쉬워요.
bg-irr-01-02.why: 쉽다 conjugates to 쉬워요 before vowel endings.

items: Conjugate ㅂ-irregular adjectives into the -워요 form before vowels
Distinguish regular ㅂ verbs like 입다 (입어요) from irregular adjectives

bg-irr-01-03.hint: ㄷ changes to ㄹ before vowel endings like -어요: 들어요.
bg-irr-01-03.why: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb: 듣 + 어요 becomes 들어요.

bg-irr-01-03.hint: 걷다 turns ㄷ into ㄹ before -어요: 걸어요.
bg-irr-01-03.why: 걷다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel endings → 걸어요.

bg-irr-01-03.hint: I listen to music in my room.
bg-irr-01-03.why: 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel endings: 들어요.

bg-irr-01-03.q: State that you walk in the park using 공원을 and 걸어요.
bg-irr-01-03.why: 걷다 turns ㄷ to ㄹ before -어요: 공원을 걸어요.

items: Change stem consonant ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel endings
Keep ㄷ intact before consonant endings like -고 and -지만

bg-irr-01-04.hint: 닫다 (to close) is a REGULAR verb: it keeps its ㄷ → 닫아요.
bg-irr-01-04.why: 닫다 is regular and does NOT soften ㄷ to ㄹ: 닫아요 (not 달아요).

bg-irr-01-04.hint: 입다 (to wear) is a REGULAR verb: it keeps ㅂ → 입어요.
bg-irr-01-04.why: 입다 is regular and does not change ㅂ to 우: 입어요 (not 이워요).

bg-irr-01-04.hint: Because the wind blows, I close the door.
bg-irr-01-04.why: 닫다 is regular and attaches -아요 to become 닫아요.

bg-irr-01-04.q: State that you wear warm clothes using 옷을 and 입어요.
bg-irr-01-04.why: 입다 is regular and attaches -어요 to become 입어요.

items: Sort regular ㄷ/ㅂ verbs from irregular ones without error
Prevent misapplying irregular rules to regular words like 닫다 and 입다
